title: Ansible Galaxy repository settings
description: The ansible member of a repository document. A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable. Local and virtual repositories have no settings of the format.

authUrl.title: Token endpoint URL
authUrl.description: For a hub behind single sign-on: where trove exchanges the stored offline token for a short-lived access token, with Authentication set to Bearer token. Leave it empty if the upstream accepts the token as it is.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: The client ID trove presents when it exchanges the token. Change it only if the hub's sign-on expects another one.

fetchDocumentation.title: Fetch documentation
fetchDocumentation.description: Fetch the documentation of each version from the upstream and keep it, so that the package page shows its documentation and contents. Turn it off to make no such requests.
